title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-prep-personal-notes-2026-10-05
content:
Weekly sync (serving-runtime / infra / console) - prep notes
Date: 2026-10-05 (sync at 10:00 PT)
Owner: Evan Martinez (note-taker)
Attendees (expected): Priya Shah, Liam Chen, Marcus Reyes, Zoe Kim, SRE on-call (TBD)
Goals for this meeting:
- Quick status on high-priority incidents or regression alerts
- Align on rollout plan for kernel selection change (canary -> grad rollout)
- Console UX: rollout of new per-model latency histogram (QA findings + enable plan)
- Action-item review from last week + owners and due dates

Agenda (30m)
1) 2m - Quick wins / blockers (round-robin)
   - Call out any immediate incidents or pager items

2) 8m - Kernel selection canary status (Priya)
   - Current canary coverage: 15% traffic on 8k seq models across prod-dedicated pool
   - Observations: 5-8% lower p95 on nvlink nodes; small regressions on some long prompt paths
   - Need decision: expand to 40% canary next week if no regressions (proposal)
   - Questions for infra: any capacity constraints for 40% canary? (Liam)

3) 8m - Console latency histogram rollout (Zoe)
   - QA findings: histogram truncation for >2000ms buckets in Safari (ticket filed)
   - Plan: disable client-side compression for Safari builds until patch; server-side fix targeted EOD Wed
   - Ask: product wants toggle to be off by default for new orgs - agree?

4) 6m - Action item review / new actions
   - Go through the list below; owners confirm progress

5) 6m - Parking lot & blockers / next steps

Personal prep notes (scratchpad)
- Remind Marcus to surface perf test logs from Friday run (path: s3://redwood-results/perf/2026-10-02)
- Follow up with infra on nvlink node allocation; ask for node list so we can pin canary to specific node set
- Draft canary expansion message for customers (short blurb + rollback plan)
- Check with product on enabling histogram toggle for beta orgs only

Action items (current)
- A1: Priya to run expanded perf regression suite against nvlink nodes by 2026-10-07 and share detailed p50/p95/p99 (owner: Priya Shah; due: 2026-10-07)
- A2: Liam to confirm capacity headroom for 40% canary and provide node allocation list (owner: Liam Chen; due: 2026-10-06)
- A3: Zoe to push Safari histogram patch and coordinate with QA for verification (owner: Zoe Kim; due: 2026-10-08)
- A4: Evan to draft customer-facing canary expansion note and circulation list (owner: Evan Martinez; due: 2026-10-06)
- A5: Marcus to upload Friday perf run logs and link to the meeting notes (owner: Marcus Reyes; due: 2026-10-05)
- A6: SRE to verify rollback playbook for kernel change and confirm runbook updates (owner: sre-oncall; due: 2026-10-07)

Notes-to-self / follow-ups after meeting
- If Priya sees p99 regressions >10% on any model, need immediate rollback plan - coordinate w/ SRE (callout)
- Prepare rollback checklist template and add to linked_artifacts (Confluence) before canary expansion
- Remind product about opt-in toggle for beta orgs (quick Slack DM to @product-hosted-api)

Parking lot
- Investigate automated smoke tests in staging for console histogram visualization (low priority)
- Long-term: evaluate model-level histogram retention policy (1 month vs 3 months)

Quick links / refs (for meeting)
- Perf dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood-inference.com/d/perf/serving-runtime
- Canary runbook (draft): confluence://teams/serving-runtime/canary-runbook
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-runtime/pull/2334
- Jira: JIRA-4821 (kernel-selection-canary)

Scratch comments (personal)
- Keep agenda tight: aim for decisions vs updates
- Call out timeline for customer notice if we expand canary (>48h notice?)
- If capacity is tight, propose rolling canary by region instead of percent

-- end of notes --
